name: Jin Ni Yiren
source:
"Problem Child" me, Class Heartthrob her—two lines that should never cross collided through a series of coincidences, shattering my monochrome world. Crave her eyes on me alone, crave her world with me alone. The pure longing in my heart gradually begins to twist.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3604510/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“问题儿童”的我，万人迷的她——两条不该交叉的线在一系列的巧合中碰撞，粉碎了我的黑白世界。渴望她的目光只看我一个人，渴望她的世界里只有我一个人。心中那份纯粹的渴望渐渐开始扭曲。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3604510/]Steam[/url]]
